name: Sukhiba WA Integration
author: udaykiranc

sections.description:
The Sukhiba WhatsApp Integration plugins allows you to send Whatsapp notifications to customers whenever they place an order, when they cancel an order, and also when an order is refunded. Enhance your customer engagement and keep them updated with real-time notifications.

The plugin also provides an option to send ad-hoc WhatsApp notification in the order details page under order actions

The plugin also provides options in settings > woo commerce > Whatsapp Notification to select the events to which customers will get Whatsapp notifications

Key Features

  • Instant Order Confirmations – Automatically send WhatsApp notifications when an order is placed.
  • Real-Time Order Updates – Keep customers informed about order status changes, cancellations, and refunds
  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration – Quick and hassle-free setup with your store.
  • Customisable Message – Personalise notifications by contacting Sukhiba.
  • Multi-Language Support – Communicate with customers in their preferred language.

Pricing

  • The plugin is provided free by Sukhiba for the first 7 days, after which integration costs apply. Standard Meta messaging charges are applicable from the start.

External services

  • Once you install the plugin, you will be automatically redirected to Sukhiba’s onboarding page, where you can seamlessly connect your Meta (Facebook) Business account.
  • After completing the onboarding, you’ll be redirected to your WooCommerce store’s /sukhiba/v1/api-key endpoint, which is generated by our plugin. This step securely stores the API key provided by Sukhiba.
  • From that point on, whenever a new order is placed or an existing order is updated, the plugin communicates with https://lite.sukhiba.com/woocommerce/webhook using the stored API key to ensure real-time order notifications.
  • By installing the plugin, you agree to Sukhiba’s Terms & Conditions.

Does this plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple languages

Support

For support and inquiries, please visit our website at lite.sukhiba.com or contact us at Your Email.

sections.installation:
1. Search for Sukhiba Whatsapp Plugin in plugin search. Click on install after opening plugin page.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings page to configure your Sukhiba API key and notification settings.
